content.diagnostic_algorithm_pregnancy: A dedicated diagnostic algorithm is proposed for suspected PE in pregnancy (Figure 7).
content.radiation_absorption: Updated information is provided on radiation absorption related to procedures used for diagnosing PE in pregnancy (Table 12).

long_term_sequelae.summary: An integrated model of patient care after PE is proposed to ensure optimal transition from hospital to community care.
long_term_sequelae.recommendations_extended: Recommendations on patient care have been extended to the entire spectrum of post-PE symptoms and functional limitation, not only CTEPH.
long_term_sequelae.follow_up_algorithm: A new comprehensive algorithm is proposed for patient follow-up after acute PE (Figure 8).

changes_in_recommendations_2014_2019.note: Summary of recommendation class changes from 2014 to 2019 (ESC 2019).

table_summary.recommendation: Rescue thrombolytic therapy is recommended for patients who deteriorate haemodynamically.
Surgical embolectomy or catheter-directed treatment should be considered as alternatives to rescue thrombolytic therapy for patients who deteriorate haemodynamically.
D-dimer measurement and clinical prediction rules should be considered to rule out PE during pregnancy or the post-partum period.
Further evaluation may be considered for asymptomatic PE survivors at increased risk for CTEPH.
